unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U20: Maintain registers and distinguish rights,liabilities and cessation

payload.title: A register is a continuing legal record
payload.core_explanation_md:
The company maintains the prescribed member and security-holder registers and indexes; depository beneficial-owner records have the described corresponding role. Entry and cessation dates, holdings and paid/unpaid amounts support the relevant rights and obligations. Inspection rights exist under the applicable conditions; do not replace them with a discretionary promise of access.

Separate statutory rights from constitutional/documentary rights and proprietary claims. Meeting, information, transfer and distribution rights have their own qualifications. A dividend is not an automatic payment merely because a person is a member, and a shareholder does not own each company asset. Liability depends on company form and unpaid obligations. Transfer, redemption, forfeiture or other cessation must be supported by the relevant valid event and records, not a convenient deletion.

self_check.prompt_text: Does deleting a name alone prove a lawful cessation?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Establish the underlying event and applicable record procedure.

payload.stem_md: A company removes a member entry without recording the claimed transfer or other legal basis. What evidence is missing?

options.text_md: Proof that every member must receive a dividend immediately
options.explanation_md: There is no such unconditional entitlement.

options.text_md: A statement that registers are optional
The valid cessation event and corresponding record trail
options.explanation_md: A deletion alone does not establish the legal change.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A deletion alone does not establish the legal change.

payload.stem_md: A shareholder claims direct ownership of a warehouse and an unconditional annual dividend. Which distinction is needed?

options.text_md: Every shareholder owns a separate room
options.explanation_md: That is not the company-property rule.

options.text_md: Membership rights differ from ownership of company assets and unconditional distributions
options.explanation_md: Each claim needs its legal basis and conditions.

options.text_md: Membership never gives any proprietary rights
options.explanation_md: That opposite claim is also wrong.

options.text_md: Only the share certificate size matters
options.explanation_md: It has no bearing on these rights.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Each claim needs its legal basis and conditions.
